title: Expand the economic calendar's event classes - collected and logged at weight 0, event-studied before any weight
note:
OPERATOR 2026-10-26 ~11:38Z, verbatim: "we may also need to expand the calendar's types of events - there are many more that could be relevant". MEASURED: the emitted live file carries 4 classes (fomc, pce, gdp, nfp), which is 4 of 13 upcoming HIGH events (manager count); KIND_TO_NEWS_CLASS in scripts/macro/econ_calendar_data.py is the only mapping, and src/news/news_events.py symbol_event_classes lists classes per symbol. TIER 3 because a class with weight changes trade-path event_risk. RULE: new classes ship DATA-ON / IMPACT-NEUTRAL - emitted and logged, weight 0 on the trade path (off the trade path != off the data path); a weight is a separate Tier-3 proposal gated on that class's event study. SOURCES (what the FXStreet US feed already carries, MEASURED in comms/macro/econ_calendar_upcoming.json 2026-10-26: initial/continuing jobless claims, durable goods, consumer confidence, EIA crude/distillate/gasoline/heating-oil/natgas stocks, API crude, Treasury bill/note auctions, MBA mortgage apps, Baker Hughes rigs, CFTC gold/oil/S&P positions; resolved-with-surprise n MEASURED across live+survey backfill: initial_jobless_claims 1170, retail_sales_mom 547, ppi_mom 542, cpi_mom 534, durable_goods 271, jolts 269, consumer_confidence 26). CANDIDATES by class -> source: US CPI/PPI/retail sales/jobless claims/JOLTS/ISM/consumer confidence -> FXStreet (kinds exist; ISM manufacturing/services and Fed-speaker kinds ARE present in the upcoming file, checked 2026-10-26); Treasury auctions -> FXStreet bill/note kinds, 3y and 10y note auctions present; EIA -> FXStreet (present); OPEC -> no kind containing opec in the upcoming file, needs a source; ECB/BoJ/BoE/China PMI+CPI -> FXStreet supports other countries but the producer fetches --countries US only, so needs a country-scope change (UNVERIFIED that those feeds carry consensus); major earnings, index rebalances, opex -> NOT covered by FMP/FXStreet calendar here, need a separate source (opex/rebalance are rule-derivable dates); crypto token unlocks and ETF flows -> NOT covered, need a separate source. PLAN: (1) Tier-1 PR after #20310: map more kinds into classes in KIND_TO_NEWS_CLASS, emit them, with news-layer weight 0 for every new class (verify against src/news/news_events.py that an unlisted class cannot reach event_risk); (2) one event-study queue unit per class - first is RQ-20261026-901 (initial_jobless_claims vs SPY); (3) weights only via a Tier-3 proposal citing that unit's verdict. NOT STARTED: only this row and RQ-20261026-901 exist. 

BUILT 2026-10-26 (lane session_01XKtTSjzhktzh6g6BKJpoYi, Tier-1 PR, weight 0 proven). MEASURED over the 162 distinct kinds in comms/macro/econ_calendar_upcoming.json (827 events, US only): N=162 kinds seen, M=14 mapped before (the 163-kind PIT log also 14); M=71 after (14 + 57 shadow). scripts/macro/econ_calendar_data.py now carries SHADOW_KIND_TO_NEWS_CLASS (+ SHADOW_KIND_PATTERNS for fed speakers): 13 classes (jobless_claims, ppi, retail_sales, ism, jolts, umich, durable_goods, adp, housing, regional_fed_mfg, industrial_activity, fed_speak, treasury_auction) from 38 listed kinds + a fed-speaker pattern, 57 of which occur in the 162; KIND_TO_NEWS_CLASS itself is untouched. WEIGHT 0 is structural: news_events.event_risk_for_symbol reads only classes listed under the symbol in symbol_event_classes and no shadow class is listed anywhere; tests/test_calendar_shadow_classes.py proves event_risk (value + meta) byte-identical with the shadow mapping on vs off for every rostered symbol and every listed base across 11 offsets around every event on a fixture, with a non-vacuity check and a negative control (listing a class does change risk), and fails if a shadow class is ever added to a symbol list (that edit IS the Tier-3 weight change). Registry: 13 economic_calendar_class_* entries in docs/reference/shadowed-features.yaml. Event studies (distinct live+survey releases with defined surprise, MEASURED 2026-10-26): RQ-20261026-901 jobless_claims 599; ten sibling units RQ-20261026-4795-01..10 (ppi 140, retail_sales 143, ism 141, jolts 136, umich 279, durable_goods 139, adp 139, housing 138, regional_fed_mfg 140, industrial_activity 138) in a separate HELD research-queue PR (E57), t-bar 3.0 for the family. fed_speak and treasury_auction have no consensus: owner CALENDAR-EVENT-REACTION-STUDY. Deliberately NOT mapped: NFP-day components (same instant as nfp), consumer_confidence (26 releases). Sources not carried (other countries, OPEC, crypto unlocks/ETF flows, earnings, opex/rebalance): pipeline PI-20261026-6BKJPOYI-0001. The emitted live file gains the new classes on the next econ-calendar-produce run after merge (a dry run on the committed captures as-of 2026-10-26 emitted 19 events: the 4 weighted ones unchanged plus 15 shadow). Roadmap/ARCHITECTURE writeback is owed when the row closes.
